# check power output fit on cluster

```{r}
here::i_am("flag_project_root.R")
here::here()
data_path = here::here()

power_df <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "/gen-avo/data-analysis/power/powersim/powercurves_quadr.csv")) 


ggplot(power_df, aes(x = nlevels, y = successes/100)) +
  geom_line(color = "#090049", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "#090049") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#090049", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Estimated Power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )+facet_wrap(~ iteration, scales = "free_y")+ylim(c(0, 1))


```

```{r}
ggplot(power_df, aes(x = nlevels, y = successes/100, group = iteration)) +
  geom_line(color = "#090049", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +

  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#090049", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Estimated Power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

```


```{r}
# Summarize across iterations
mean_power_df <- power_df %>%
  group_by(nlevels) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_power = mean(successes/100, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower = mean_power - sd(successes/100, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper = mean_power + sd(successes/100, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot single mean curve with ribbon
ggplot(mean_power_df, aes(x = nlevels, y = mean_power)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#FF69B4", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(color = "#FF69B4", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#FF69B4", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Estimated Power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )


```


```{r}
# Subset for power ~0.8 and ~0.9
power_sub <- power_df %>%
  filter((mean >= 0.80 & mean < 0.9) | (mean >= 0.9 & mean <= 0.99)) %>%
  mutate(power_group = case_when(
    mean >= 0.80 & mean < 0.9 ~ "80-89% Power",
    mean >= 0.90 & mean <= 0.99 ~ "90-99% Power"
  ))

# Overview of distribution of nlevels (sample size aka ppt) for each power group
ggplot(power_sub, aes(x = power_group, y = nlevels, fill = power_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter()+
  facet_wrap(~ power_group, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Power Group",
    y = "N Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )+ scale_fill_manual(values = c("80-89% Power" = "#090049", 
                               "90-99% Power" = "#FF69B4")) 

power_means <- power_sub %>%
  group_by(power_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_nlevels = mean(nlevels, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_successes = mean(successes, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_power = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = n()
  )
power_means

```
